comments.feedback: Eric explains concepts very clearly with an emphasis on intuition and he encourages students to understand the material being presented rather solely on rote memory. His enthusiasm for chemistry is contagious. He is extremely welcoming, knowledgeable, approachable, and responsive to questions, and he takes the time to make sure students understand what is going on. The course is easy to navigate and students are not limited by access to learning resources (e.g., lecture recordings, lecture notes, practice problems/exams). Before taking course, I did not feel that I had a solid foundation in chemistry from previous classes. Eric’s class truly helped me to patch those areas of insufficient knowledge and to develop a greater understanding and enthusiasm for chemistry. I’d highly recommend this class to other students. I think this class is one of the few classes I’ve taken at UCLA with such a strong emphasis on intuition and a deep understanding of the material. Having taken this class, I’m excited for future chemistry classes.
